selection_basis: Editorial selection after reading these abstracts; relevance to AIDB memory, RAG, evaluation and agent reliability. This is not an exhaustive review of the discovery corpus.

papers.reason: Separate query-planning failures from retrieval failures and evidence sufficiency.
Compare raw-history retrieval with lossy memory construction.
Resolve updates before multi-hop evidence selection.
Admit or reject stale memory when an agent returns after a pause.
Evaluate memory with executable downstream coding outcomes.
Measure compression cost, latency and task success together.
Check source support for decisions introduced by context compaction.
Use traces and runtime memory state to localize architecture repairs.
Evaluate interaction between personal memory and procedural skills.
Measure implicit multimodal evidence, retrieval noise and refusal.
Isolate memory delivery from retrieval with matched evidence.
Inspect evidence-sufficiency benchmark leakage and out-of-domain limits.
Test remembering, verification, clarification and actual tool choices.
Assess memory-injection defenses, efficiency and transfer limits.
Distinguish relevant historical documents from currently valid evidence.
